s01: Your recorded voice sounds wrong to you and right to everyone else.
s02: It is not a bad recording. You are missing half of what you usually hear.
s03: When you speak, the sound reaches you two ways.
s04: Most of it leaves your mouth, travels through the air, and comes back into your ears.
s05: The rest goes straight through your skull.
s06: Bone carries low frequencies well, and high ones badly.
s07: So the voice inside your head has a bass line nobody else is getting.
s08: This is the voice in your head.
s09: And this is the one that leaves the room.
s10: The recording is not wrong. It is the half that gets out.
s11: You have simply never heard the voice everyone else knows you by.
